classification: 직접 확인 of current official HTML; project implications are 추정·판단

sources.directFindings: Doorway abuse includes substantially similar geography/query pages funnelling to a usable destination. Scaled content abuse concerns mass content without user value regardless of production method. Keyword stuffing and scraped/lightly modified copies are also covered.
sources.projectImplication: Code/layout reuse is compatible with original useful content, but district-name substitutions or artificial facility×intent×dong URL expansion are risky. One grouped page must be a useful answer and buying path, not merely a funnel. This is risk analysis, not a Google enforcement determination.

sources.directFindings: Official questions emphasize original analysis, completeness, clear sourcing, truthful expertise and enough information to achieve a goal. The page explicitly rejects a preferred word-count assumption.
sources.projectImplication: 2,500–3,000 Korean body characters is the user's editorial target, not Google's threshold. Original facility policy + verified products + honest total-price consultation should solve the purchase question. Do not invent experience, delivery cases or filler.

sources.directFindings: Current official spam examples include keyword repetition, template mass production with only sentence changes, automated scraping and misleading phone/address/link content. Technology alone does not determine the violation.
sources.projectImplication: Use current official venue identity and contact data, avoid mechanically reskinned region pages, and do not turn merchant directory errors into local facts.

sources.directFindings: Naver recommends precise titles/descriptions, consistent subject coverage, credible sources, truthful original contributions, readable structure, textual key facts and current prices/policies. More repeated keywords do not guarantee higher exposure.
sources.projectImplication: Render actual FAQs/product terms as text, show real SKU destination links, retain brief official sources, and review the seller voice across all exposed copy.

sources.directFindings: Same-content multiple hostnames/URLs should be consolidated; canonical/redirects identify representative URLs. Site maps, crawlable resources, meaningful HTTP errors and mobile usability are covered.
sources.projectImplication: Avoid independent URLs for synonyms; technical future testing must inspect actual canonical, sitemap, noindex, true404 and mobile output. No runtime changes were made here.

notInferred: No minimum word count for indexation
No automatic penalty for any content reuse
No ranking guarantee from source count or article count
No current indexing or search performance confirmed
evidence: raw/http-readbacks.json and raw/http-readbacks-supplement.json bind every document to original URL, HTTP200, capture time, bytes, hashes and saved HTML/text.
